name: sonic-lessons-page-voice
step: v12-flight 9: lessons passed end to end in the real page by a scripted keyboard pilot
voice: the engine speaks with the browser's own voices (speed 1)
note: headless Chrome runs muted (--mute-audio); how anything sounds is not judged here

captionLines: Is this sound in front of you or behind you? Press 1 for in front, 2 for behind, 3 if you are not sure.
Your headphones work well. You are ready for the next step.

checks.name: ears-headphones: the page flies the lesson (the mode runs, the engine runs, one AudioContext, the helper's view is drawn)
ears-headphones: the captions cover nothing the page draws and stay above the view's centre (2 or more lines, no element of the page under them)
ears-headphones: passed end to end by the keyboard (the lesson's own 'passed' event)
ears-headphones: progress saved in the prefs collection (passed, attempts, successes)
ears-headphones: the lesson's lines are speech events of the mode (the captions' source)
ears-headphones: with the voice on, the lines reach speechSynthesis (at least 3 utterances) and an interrupt cancels what was queued

first: Let's check your headphones. Wired headphones work best, and the volume should be comfortable, never loud.

checks.name: ears-headphones: the speech queue ran empty at least twice (speech.end markers, the replay's input)
ears-headphones: the engine made sound (RMS over 1e-3 at some point) and held the ceiling (peak at most 0.5013)
ears-headphones: three questions answered by digit keys, right (the lesson says the headphones work well)
ears-headphones: after the pass the next lesson of the path opens (ears-glossary) and the page goes on (scene lesson-ears-headphones, engine running, one AudioContext)
shapes-square: the page flies the lesson (the mode runs, the engine runs, one AudioContext, the helper's view is drawn)
shapes-square: the captions cover nothing the page draws and stay above the view's centre (2 or more lines, no element of the page under them)
shapes-square: passed end to end by the keyboard (the lesson's own 'passed' event)
shapes-square: progress saved in the prefs collection (passed, attempts, successes)
shapes-square: the lesson's lines are speech events of the mode (the captions' source)
shapes-square: with the voice on, the lines reach speechSynthesis (at least 3 utterances) and an interrupt cancels what was queued

first: A square gate has four bars. Its sound ticks at each corner.

checks.name: shapes-square: the engine made sound (RMS over 1e-3 at some point) and held the ceiling (peak at most 0.5013)
shapes-square: gates passed, each inside the opening
shapes-square: after the pass the next lesson of the path opens (shapes-series) and the page goes on (scene lesson-shapes-series, engine running, one AudioContext)
G opens the sound glossary from a lesson (ears-glossary runs, the helper's view is the glossary's floor)
no console errors and no missing file (but the favicon and the API the dev server does not have)
